verdict.rationale: Featurebase explicitly markets a centralized feedback portal that consolidates insights from a feedback portal, in-app widgets, and integrations, letting users vote on ideas with a public roadmap — directly matching the searchable repository story, and it supports intake from multiple channels (in-app, Slack, Discord, Email) into one inbox. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence confirming search functionality quality or actual cross-team usage at scale.
